title: Climate Change Resilience Act 2019 (Act No. 9 of 2019), Cap. 30.03
citation: Climate Change Resilience Act 2019 (Act 9 of 2019), 2022 Revised Edition, Cap. 30.03
evidence: Printed under the title of the Act in the 2022 Revised Edition and in the Act as enacted: "Commencement [1st July 2019]". Opened https://tuvalu-legislation.tv/cms/images/LEGISLATION/PRINCIPAL/2019/2019-0009/2019-0009_2.pdf on 2026-11-09.
notes: Climate framework act: creates the Department of Climate Change and Disaster, the National Climate Change Resilience Forum and the National Advisory Council on Climate Change, sets greenhouse gas emissions reduction targets (section 9) and prohibits exploring, mining or extracting fossil fuels with a corporate fine (section 27). Official copies on tuvalu-legislation.tv: as enacted (_1.pdf, sha256 960a57b6047b22b1c9854fbf437f481f2ce54da57a3ce93ea5efc5158faecf0d) and 2022 Revised Edition (_2.pdf, sha256 bfcf07051e00a11b79c97538d119d9d8a79e870d2f9341a8ac038275a3a9f9db). The earlier official_source_url on www.tuvaluclimatechange.gov.tv is replaced by the tuvalu-legislation.tv copy (the climate change host did not answer from the laptop address on 2026-11-09). Row TV-LEGISLATION-ADOPTED / TV-LEGISLATION-CONSOLIDATED is permission requested (site copyright notice: copying in unaltered form only, commercialising needs permission of the Government of Tuvalu), so no text is stored. English only; no Tuvaluan text or government translation was found on the site.
